Alex - great, thanks for the clarity. Below are answers to the items you called out and a proposed timeline. I’ll also attach our working SIG answers and the SOC 2 exec summary. Dev is on cc for any technical deep dives.

Answers:
- Timeline: We can prioritize the SIG and initial answers; target to return a completed SIG draft by 2026-11-11 (3 business days). Final clarifications after your tech review by 11/12 is reasonable.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (coverage period through 2025-08). We can provide the executive summary immediately (attached) and the full report via secure link after a mutual NDA or under your vendor portal controls. Link to summary: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2_Redwood_202508.pdf
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-compliant deployments. We do offer a BAA for customers processing PHI. For hosted API customers, a BAA can be established; Dedicated and Private options are available and often preferred for larger PHI volumes.
- Deployment & PHI: Hosted API (Redwood cloud) can process PHI under BAA; Dedicated (reserved capacity) and Private (VPC/on-prem) are also supported. We’ll work with legal for the appropriate scoping in the BAA.
- Data residency: We support region controls (US, EU). For your pilot we can scope to US-only processing and storage.
- Encryption & KMS: TLS 1.2+/TLS 1.3 in transit; AES-256 at rest. We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and can discuss HSM options for Dedicated/Private.
- SLA & uptime: We offer SLA options on Dedicated and Private tiers; hosted API SLA is available for enterprise plans. I’ve linked the SLA summary in the related links.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Answers.xlsx (working answers - see open cells flagged with "ACTION: security"), SOC2_Redwood_202508.pdf (exec summary).

Technical owner for in-depth SIG items: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>. Dev - Novamed may have a few CAIQ-technical items around key rotation and KV cache handling; can you review the attached and flag anything that needs a deeper response?
